summary: Mizuho Financial Group filed a Form 6-K announcing its capital ratios as of June 30, 2026, under Basel international standards. The filing reports consolidated CET1 ratio of 13.51%, Tier 1 of 15.94%, and total capital ratio of 17.74%, with total capital of ¥14,590.7 billion and risk-weighted assets of ¥82,213.7 billion. This is a routine regulatory disclosure of financial condition, not a special-situation transaction. No deal terms, M&A activity, or corporate actions are involved. The filing serves solely to report regulatory capital metrics to investors and is incorporated into the company's F-3 shelf prospectus.
